name: retrieval expectations
description: Fixed queries with the memories that must and must not come back. `mustExclude` entries that are superseded or deleted are additionally required to appear in the result's `excluded` list with the matching reason -- proving the memory was scored, considered and withheld by the lifecycle rather than simply never matched.

queries.intent: The current city, not the two the user has left.

queries.query: what city am I based in
queries.intent: Different phrasing, same slot, same answer.
The decisive identity test. Two memories hold the value Pune; only the newer one is current, and the original stays superseded rather than being revived.
A superseded value must never surface, even when it is the only textual match in the store.
Current employer only; both previous employers are superseded.
Two-link chain: the root of the employer chain is still withheld.
The promotion superseded the old title.
The query term is the stale value. Relevance must not override lifecycle.
Direct value match on the current fact.
Current time zone only.
The current number was purged and the previous one is superseded, so the correct answer is nothing at all -- not the old number.
Multi-valued attribute: every value is current and all must come back.
Value match on one member of a multi-valued attribute.
A soft-deleted preference must not come back, while its siblings still do.
Deleted memories are withheld even on an exact value match.
Multi-token value match.
likes and dislikes are separate attributes and must not bleed into each other.

queries.query: what programming languages do I know
queries.intent: Three skills, all current, within the result limit.
Folded plural must still reach the singular attribute alias.
All three goals are current.
Attribute alias match on a multi-valued attribute.
An unresolved contradiction: both values come back, flagged contested, and neither is presented as settled.
The second ambiguous conflict. Sam and Samir both stay active.

queries.query: where did I used to live
queries.intent: A documented limitation. The engine has no model of tense, so it answers with the current city and the superseded ones stay withheld. Recorded here so the gap is visible rather than discovered later.

queries.query: tell me about my cat Mishti
queries.intent: Attribute alias and value token both match the same memory.
Nothing relevant exists. Retrieval must return nothing rather than the best of a bad set.
